results.text: [The role of metformin in the cardiokidney-metabolic patient]. Metformin is a first-line drug in the treatment of type2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) due to its efficacy, safety, and cost-effectiveness. Its main mechanism of action is the reduction of hepatic gluconeogenesis, improving insulin sensitivity and modulating glucose metabolism. Metformin-mediated protection against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity. A phase II clinical trial of metformin (MET) for the treatment of doxorubicin (DOX)-induced cardiotoxicity (NCT02472353) failed. The aims of this study were to confirm MET-mediated protection against DOX-induced cardiotoxicity and its mechanism using H9C2 cells, and to establish a Wistar rat model of DOX-induced cardiotoxicity.
